exact_reasons: P2.5 did NOT implement true fold-specific walk-forward training. It generated full-dataset predictions from the existing model and sliced those predictions into outer folds.
The existing model was trained through December 2024. It was then used to evaluate folds beginning in March 2021. Those folds are contaminated by future-trained model information.
cross_fitted_meta: true was written into the report without implementing cross-fitted meta-model training.
Every outer fold used the same model and scaler hashes — no fold-specific training occurred.
Fold 5 incorrectly included a 2026 timestamp in the development WFO period.
Runtime feature_stream_v2.py still uses np.nan_to_num and a zero-vector fallback.
The actual Exness shadow runner still contains hard-coded safe-state values and imports automatic calibration generation.
P2.5 stress reports contain notes/placeholders instead of executed stress scenarios.
P2.5 calibrated only the alpha probability stream and did not implement separate fold-specific alpha and meta calibration.
statement: PF 9.5775 and Sharpe 3.9568 are NOT valid nested-WFO evidence. They were computed from a single model trained on 2020-2024 data, then sliced into folds that begin in 2021 — this is OOS contamination. The metrics are invalid and must not be used as competition evidence.
